title: Axis Biology — Orientation, Autonomic Side-Chains, Sensory Roots, Plexuses and Living Boundaries
status: specialist biology/neurobiology deepening with project comparators
purpose: Capture important biological systems missed by a simple brain-spine-CSF diagram: vestibular orientation, paired sympathetic trunks, dorsal-root sensory ganglia, vagal return, autonomic plexuses, enteric nervous system, adrenal amplification, respiratory/phrenic axis, meninges and choroid/blood-CSF interfaces.
epistemic_rule: Biological descriptions remain physiological. Hermes/caduceus/chakra/Potatoverse relations are separately labeled structural or functional comparisons.

systems.biology: Semicircular canals and otolith organs encode head rotation, linear acceleration and gravity-related orientation. Vestibular nuclei project into cerebellar, thalamic, cortical and hippocampal/navigation networks. Anterior thalamic head-direction circuitry participates in representations of heading.
systems.project_value: A strong biological neighbor for Axis / orientation / 'which way is up' / North language.
systems.important_boundary: Head-direction cells encode heading relative to an environment and sensory landmarks; they are not known as magnetic-north or theological North detectors.
relations: vestibular nuclei → anterior thalamus → retrosplenial/entorhinal networks

systems.biology: Left and right sympathetic trunks are longitudinal chains of interconnected paravertebral ganglia running alongside the vertebral column from skull-base/cervical regions toward the coccyx. Preganglionic sympathetic neurons arise mainly from thoracolumbar cord levels and may synapse at the same level, ascend/descend in the chain, or pass toward prevertebral ganglia.
systems.project_value: Best real anatomical neighbor for 'paired side channels' next to a central vertebral axis.
systems.serpent_comparison: Two long bilateral chains visually invite comparison with paired serpents/iḍā-piṅgalā/caduceus, which explains some modern physiological reinterpretations.
systems.boundary: The sympathetic trunks do not normally form two helices crossing around the spinal cord. They are not iḍā and piṅgalā in established anatomy.

systems.biology: Dorsal root ganglia are repeated bilateral swellings on sensory roots containing primary sensory-neuron cell bodies. They sit at spinal levels near the intervertebral foramina and bring somatic/visceral sensory information toward the cord.
systems.project_value: Repeated sensory nodes / report stations along the Ladder.
systems.boundary: DRG are not chakras and should not be assigned spiritual qualities by vertebral coincidence.

systems.biology: The vagus (cranial nerve X) is bilateral and predominantly sensory/afferent; much visceral information from thoracic and abdominal organs reaches the nucleus tractus solitarius in the medulla. Parasympathetic efferents also regulate organs.
systems.project_value: A powerful Return / inward-report route from body toward brainstem, plus a downward regulatory route.
systems.linguistic_note: Latin vagus means wandering, fitting its extensive distribution as a historical anatomical name.
systems.boundary: The vagus is not a central spinal channel and is not kundalini. The common ~80% afferent estimate is an anatomical population statement, not '80% of spirit goes upward'.

systems.biology: The celiac or solar plexus is the largest autonomic plexus, a dense network around the celiac/superior mesenteric arterial origins near the upper abdomen. It contains sympathetic, parasympathetic and visceral-afferent components serving abdominal organs.
systems.project_value: This is the strongest literal biological neighbor for modern 'solar plexus' / navel-center language.
systems.boundary: The anatomical celiac plexus is not the historical Maṇipūra cakra; their identification is a modern comparative/physiological mapping.

systems.biology: The enteric nervous system contains extensive neuronal and glial networks in the gastrointestinal wall. It can coordinate motility, secretion and local blood flow through intrinsic circuits while communicating bidirectionally with CNS, autonomic, endocrine, immune and microbial/metabolic systems.
systems.project_value: Garden / Navel / digestion / local intelligence / roots that can work locally yet report to House.
systems.boundary: 'Second brain' is a useful popular shorthand, not a second conscious person or independent mind.

systems.biology: Adrenal medulla is often described as a modified sympathetic ganglion: preganglionic sympathetic fibers activate chromaffin cells, producing circulating catecholamines that extend/amplify sympathetic responses.
systems.project_value: A biological amplifier linking neural command to whole-body chemical mobilization; useful neighbor for Forge/Heat/activation.
systems.boundary: Adrenal catecholamines are not spiritual fire or chakra energy.

systems.biology: Phrenic nerves arise principally from C3-C5 and descend through the thorax to drive the diaphragm, linking cervical spinal levels to the main muscle of inspiration.
systems.project_value: A concrete cervical→thoracic Breath route underneath Throat/Breath symbolism.
systems.boundary: Breathing is coordinated by distributed brainstem, spinal, peripheral and chemical feedback systems; phrenic nerve alone is not Breath/Spirit.

systems.biology: Dura, arachnoid and pia form molecularly and functionally distinct meningeal layers around brain and spinal cord. The subarachnoid space contains CSF; meninges also contain vessels, nerves, immune cells and lymphatic drainage structures.
systems.project_value: Nested sheaths / walls / courts around the neural Axis and House; a better biological architecture for protection than one imaginary membrane.
systems.boundary: Meninges are not aura layers or subtle bodies.

systems.biology: Choroid plexus is a vascularized epithelial interface in the ventricles that produces a large fraction of CSF and forms the blood-CSF barrier. Fenestrated capillaries are separated from ventricular CSF by tight-junctioned choroid epithelial cells; transport and immune signaling regulate the ventricular environment.
systems.project_value: Spring / Well / living water-making boundary inside the House-complex.
systems.boundary: It does not produce Spirit or purify moral contamination.

systems.biology: Circumventricular organs are specialized ventricular-border regions with vascular/barrier properties differing from conventional BBB, enabling sensory or secretory communication between blood, brain and ventricular interfaces.
systems.project_value: Window family: controlled sensing/secretion where ordinary barrier rules differ.
systems.boundary: Biological windows are not dimensional portals.

chakra_biological_neighbors.rule: modern anatomical neighborhood, not ancient one-to-one anatomy
heart symbolism and subjective chest feeling are distributed brain-body phenomena
voice/breath center is a regional functional overlay
pineal is a project/esoteric comparator, not the sole biological Brow organ
Crown is primarily subtle-body/project orientation, not a single brain structure

serpent_anatomy_comparison.strongest_visual_neighbor: paired sympathetic trunks beside the vertebral axis
serpent_anatomy_comparison.strongest_central_axis_neighbor: spinal cord + vertebral column, with important distinction from subtle central channel
serpent_anatomy_comparison.strongest_fluid_neighbor: subarachnoid CSF around brain/spinal cord, not a large central canal
serpent_anatomy_comparison.warning: Taken together these can produce a caduceus-like modern diagram, but the composite is constructed by the interpreter; biology does not present a literal caduceus.

orientation_house_extension.finding: Vestibular signals reach thalamic networks and contribute to head-direction/navigation systems including the anterodorsal thalamus.
orientation_house_extension.house_upgrade: Add an Orientation/Heading room or function to the anterior thalamic House alongside its memory/spatial role.
orientation_house_extension.north_boundary: The project may compare this to North/orientation, but should state that the neural code is environmental heading rather than an intrinsic compass pointing to geographic or sacred North.
